What We Offer

Our Dental Services

Comprehensive care from routine check-ups to advanced cosmetic and surgical procedures — all delivered with precision, comfort and expertise under one roof.

✦

Teeth Whitening

Achieve a radiant, luminous smile with our professional-grade whitening treatments. Using advanced peroxide-based gels and LED light activation, we safely lift deep stains caused by coffee, tea, wine, tobacco and ageing — brightening your smile by up to 8 shades in a single visit. Safe, long-lasting results with minimal sensitivity.

◈

Dental Bonding

Restore chipped, cracked or discoloured teeth with precision composite resin bonding. The tooth-coloured material is carefully sculpted, shaped and polished directly onto your tooth to blend seamlessly with your natural enamel. A quick, painless and affordable solution to dramatically improve the appearance of your smile in just one appointment.

◉

Routine Check-ups

Prevention is the foundation of lifelong oral health. Our comprehensive dental examinations include thorough clinical assessment of teeth, gums and soft tissues, digital X-ray evaluation, oral cancer screening, bite analysis and personalised hygiene guidance. We detect potential issues early, saving you time, discomfort and expense in the long run.

❋

Cosmetic Dentistry

Transform your smile with our bespoke cosmetic dentistry solutions tailored to your unique facial aesthetics. We combine art and science to design smiles that look natural, balanced and beautiful. From subtle enhancements to complete smile makeovers, our treatments are customised to complement your skin tone, lip shape and facial harmony.

⬡

Dental Implants

Reclaim the confidence of a full, natural smile with titanium dental implants — the gold standard for permanent tooth replacement. Surgically placed into the jawbone to fuse with bone over time, implants provide a stable, lifelike foundation for crowns or bridges. They preserve bone structure, prevent shifting of adjacent teeth and can last a lifetime with proper care.

⬢

Dentures & Bridges

Restore your ability to eat, speak and smile confidently with custom-fabricated dentures and dental bridges. Full and partial dentures are crafted for optimal fit, comfort and aesthetics, while fixed bridges permanently replace one or more missing teeth by anchoring to adjacent natural teeth or implants — all designed to look indistinguishable from your natural dentition.

✚

Emergency Dental Care

Dental emergencies demand immediate, expert attention. We offer same-day priority appointments for severe toothache, dental abscesses, fractured or knocked-out teeth, lost crowns, broken fillings and trauma-related injuries. Our calm, experienced team will stabilise your condition, manage pain promptly and provide a clear treatment plan to restore your oral health quickly.

◇

Tooth Extractions

When a tooth cannot be saved through restorative treatment, our gentle extraction technique ensures the procedure is as comfortable as possible. Using precise local anaesthesia and atraumatic instruments, we minimise discomfort during and after the procedure. We also provide detailed post-extraction care instructions and discuss tooth replacement options to restore your complete smile.

◆

Fillings & Sealants

Tooth-coloured composite fillings restore decayed or damaged teeth to their natural form and function — with no unsightly metal in sight. For younger patients and those prone to decay, we apply protective fissure sealants to back teeth, creating a smooth barrier that prevents food and bacteria from settling in deep grooves, significantly reducing the risk of cavities.

⌖

Laser Dentistry

Experience the future of dental treatment with precision soft-tissue laser procedures. Laser dentistry allows us to reshape gum tissue, treat gum disease, remove small lesions and perform biopsies with minimal bleeding, swelling and post-operative discomfort. The laser sterilises as it works, reducing infection risk and dramatically accelerating healing compared to traditional techniques.

◯

Mouth Guards

Protect your teeth from nocturnal grinding (bruxism) and sports-related trauma with custom-fitted oral appliances. Unlike over-the-counter options, our professionally fabricated mouth guards are precision-moulded from dental impressions of your own teeth — ensuring a perfect fit, superior comfort and maximum protection for your teeth, jaw joints and surrounding muscles.

⊕

Oral Surgery

Our clinic provides a range of minor oral surgical procedures in a safe, comfortable clinical environment. This includes surgical extraction of impacted wisdom teeth, removal of cysts or benign growths, exposure of unerupted teeth for orthodontic treatment, and pre-prosthetic surgery to prepare the mouth for implants or dentures. All procedures are performed under appropriate anaesthesia for your comfort.

✿

Paediatric Dentistry

We believe every child deserves to grow up with a healthy, happy smile. Our paediatric dental care is delivered in a warm, bright and child-friendly environment designed to reduce anxiety and build positive associations with dental visits. We offer preventive treatments, fluoride applications, habit counselling for thumb-sucking and pacifier use, and early orthodontic assessment for growing children.

⊗

Root Canal Treatment

Modern root canal therapy is nothing to fear. When infection reaches the inner pulp of a tooth, our precise endodontic treatment removes the infected tissue, thoroughly disinfects the canals and seals the space to prevent re-infection — all while preserving your natural tooth. Using rotary instrumentation and advanced techniques, the procedure is performed comfortably and efficiently with minimal sessions.

◌

Teeth Cleaning

Professional teeth cleaning by our dental team goes far beyond what a toothbrush can achieve at home. Using ultrasonic scalers and hand instruments, we meticulously remove hardened calculus and biofilm from all surfaces of your teeth and below the gumline. Your teeth are then polished to remove surface staining, leaving them smooth, clean and refreshingly healthy — and your gums protected from periodontal disease.

◈

Teeth Reshaping

Enameloplasty — or teeth reshaping — is a minimally invasive cosmetic procedure that removes tiny amounts of enamel to correct minor imperfections. Ideal for smoothing rough edges, correcting slightly overlapping teeth, reducing pointed canines or evening out length discrepancies, the treatment is quick, painless and requires no anaesthesia. Results are immediate and permanently improve the symmetry and aesthetics of your smile.

✦

Veneers & Crowns

Porcelain veneers are ultra-thin, custom-crafted shells bonded to the front surface of teeth to correct colour, shape, size and alignment — delivering a flawless, magazine-worthy smile. Dental crowns encase the entire tooth to restore its strength, shape and function after decay, fracture or root canal treatment. Both are fabricated with exceptional precision to achieve results that are beautiful, durable and completely natural-looking.

⊠

Digital X-Ray

Our clinic uses advanced digital radiography for comprehensive diagnostic imaging. Compared to traditional film X-rays, digital X-rays emit up to 90% less radiation, produce instant high-resolution images and allow us to magnify, enhance and precisely analyse your dental structures. This enables earlier detection of cavities between teeth, bone loss, impacted teeth, infections and other concerns that are invisible to the naked eye.
